title: [Feature Request] Add the option to manually sort books / groups of books
summary: I like having my collections manually sorted, and I'd rather not use the workaround of placing a number in front of each collection and then sorting by name, which is very tedious and looks kinda bad. Thank you for the frequent updates and improvements!

title: Remove NSXML workarounds
summary: When #16 lands, the engine and the designer will be using our own custom XFDOM. Retire the two workarounds the XFDOM makes unnecessary: * the ` ` whitespace markers in `XFProcessor` * the CDATA token substitution in `XFSubmission` Those exist to paper over NSXML behaviour and are now dead weight, but they're behaviour changes in the engine's core rather than a back-end removal, so they belong in their own commit with the W3C suite as the check.
